title: Score result
description: What the scorer publishes on score-results after writing it to Postgres, and the app consumes: one PR's predicted outcome, its rank and band (ADR 0019), and the versions that made them. A PR is either ranked (rank_score, rank_band and model_version set, unranked_reason null) or unranked with a reason and still shown. The feature vector is not carried here; it is in the score log (ADR 0024).
x-riffle-code-checks: ranked (rank_score, rank_band, model_version set and unranked_reason null) or unranked (rank_score and rank_band null, unranked_reason set), never half
p_merge = p_lands_clean + p_lands_after_rework when both are set

delivery_id.description: The PR event's delivery_id; one result per delivery (scoring is idempotent on it)

head_sha.description: Head commit of the PR when the event happened

trigger.description: The PR event's action that caused this score

p_lands_clean.description: Chance the PR is merged without rework

p_lands_after_rework.description: Chance the PR is merged after rework

p_goes_nowhere.description: Chance the PR is never merged

p_reason_abandoned.description: Given it goes nowhere, chance the reason is abandoned

p_reason_duplicate.description: Given it goes nowhere, chance the reason is duplicate

p_reason_unwanted.description: Given it goes nowhere, chance the reason is unwanted

p_reason_ci_technical.description: Given it goes nowhere, chance the reason is ci_technical

p_reason_unknown.description: Given it goes nowhere, chance the reason is unknown

p_label_szz_bug.description: Chance of a later bug fix traced back to it

rank_score.description: The number the queue is sorted by, from the repo's ranking mode (ADR 0019); null when unranked

rank_mode.description: The ranking mode that made rank_score (ADR 0019); merge_first = p_lands_clean + 0.6 x p_lands_after_rework

rank_band.description: Band from the repo's rank_bands; null when unranked

model_version.description: The registered model version and variant used, pinned for this request (e.g. riffle-outcome-setup-g/7/new_repos); null when no model was available

miner_version.description: Version of the miner that made the features (ADR 0027)

layer_weight.description: The repo layer's share of the score; 0 while no repo layer is served

unranked_reason.description: Why the PR has no rank; null when ranked. An unranked PR is still shown (fail open)

scored_at.description: When the result was written, RFC 3339 in UTC

explanation.description: One sentence from the explainer; null when it was slow, down or off. The rank is valid either way
